```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

df_data <- readRDS(here("outputs", "df_data.rds"))
df_paired <- readRDS(here("outputs", "df_paired.rds"))
```

Helper functions
```{r}
smd_independent <- function(m_trt, sd_trt, n_trt, m_ref, sd_ref, n_ref,
                            type = c("g", "d")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  
  sp <- sqrt(((n_trt - 1) * sd_trt^2 + (n_ref - 1) * sd_ref^2) / (n_trt + n_ref - 2))
  d  <- (m_trt - m_ref) / sp
  
  J  <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (n_trt + n_ref) - 9)
  g  <- J * d
  
  yi <- if (type == "d") d else g
  
  vi <- (n_trt + n_ref) / (n_trt * n_ref) + yi^2 / (2 * (n_trt + n_ref - 2))
  tibble(y = yi, se_y = sqrt(vi), var_y = vi, d = d, g = g, J = J)
}

smd_from_t <- function(t, n_trt, n_ref, type = c("g", "d")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  d  <- t * sqrt(1 / n_trt + 1 / n_ref)
  J  <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (n_trt + n_ref) - 9)
  g  <- J * d
  yi <- if (type == "d") d else g
  vi <- (n_trt + n_ref) / (n_trt * n_ref) + yi^2 / (2 * (n_trt + n_ref - 2))
  tibble(y = yi, se_y = sqrt(vi), var_y = vi, d = d, g = g, J = J)
}
```

```{r}
# TRUE if any overlap, FALSE if none; NA if either side missing/empty
lang_overlap <- function(a, b) {
  A <- str_split(a, ",")
  B <- str_split(b, ",")
  # mapply(function(x, y) {
  #   if (length(x) == 0 || length(y) == 0) return(NA)
  #   length(intersect(x, y)) > 0
  # }, A, B)
  map2_lgl(A, B, \(x, y) {
    if (length(x) == 0 || length(y) == 0) return(NA)
    if ("zho" %in% x && ("cmn" %in% y || "yue" %in% y)) return(TRUE)
    if ("zho" %in% y && ("cmn" %in% x || "yue" %in% x)) return(TRUE)
    length(intersect(x, y)) > 0
  })
}
```

```{r}
nma_arm_of <- function(lang_group, vocab_measure) {
  case_when(
    lang_group == "monolingual"                                        ~ 1L,
    lang_group != "monolingual" & vocab_measure == "language-specific" ~ 2L,
    lang_group != "monolingual" & vocab_measure == "total"             ~ 3L,
    lang_group != "monolingual" & vocab_measure == "conceptual"        ~ 4L
  )
}

score_lang_of <- function(lang_group, nma_arm, L1, L2, tool_L1, tool_L2) {
  case_when(
    lang_group == "monolingual"                      ~ L1,
    nma_arm == 2L & !is.na(tool_L1)                  ~ L1,
    nma_arm == 2L & is.na(tool_L1) & !is.na(tool_L2) ~ L2,
    nma_arm %in% c(3L, 4L)                           ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```


# Assigning arms
```{r}
df_arms <- df_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(vocab_score_mean), !is.na(vocab_score_sd), !is.na(N),
    vocab_measure %in% c("language-specific", "total", "conceptual") |
      lang_group == "monolingual"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    nma_arm = nma_arm_of(lang_group, vocab_measure), 
    # Language this score represents (only meaningful for mono + bi_L1 arm)
    score_language = score_lang_of(lang_group, nma_arm, L1, L2, 
                                   assessment_tool_L1, assessment_tool_L2)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(nma_arm))

grand_age_mean <- mean(c(df_arms$age_mean, df_paired$age_mean_1, df_paired$age_mean_2),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
df_dropped <- df_data |> 
  filter(is.na(vocab_score_mean) | is.na(vocab_score_sd) | is.na(N)) |>
  filter(!short_cite %in% df_paired$short_cite)
```


# Building contrasts
```{r}
df_contrasts <- df_arms |>
  group_by(short_cite, compare_group, vocab_type, vocab_units, 
           infant_typical, assessment_procedure) |> # include for more moderators
  group_modify(function(grp, key) {
    
    mono    <- grp |> filter(nma_arm == 1L)
    non_ref <- grp |> filter(nma_arm != 1L)
    if (nrow(non_ref) == 0L) return(tibble())
    
    if (nrow(mono) > 0L) {
      # Has monolingual: cross all trt × ref ppt pairs, then filter by language
      pairs <- cross_join(
        non_ref |> select(arm_trt = nma_arm, ppt_trt = ppt_group,
                          m_trt   = vocab_score_mean, sd_trt = vocab_score_sd,
                          n_trt   = N, age_trt = age_mean,
                          lang_trt = score_language, L1, L2),
        mono |>    select(arm_ref = nma_arm, ppt_ref = ppt_group,
                          m_ref   = vocab_score_mean, sd_ref = vocab_score_sd,
                          n_ref   = N, age_ref = age_mean,
                          lang_ref = score_language)
      ) |>
        filter(
          # bi_L1 (arm 2): only match when score languages agree
          # bi_total / bi_conceptual (arms 3,4): no language restriction
          arm_trt != 2L |
            (lang_overlap(lang_trt, lang_ref) %in% TRUE)
        )
    } else {
      # Bi-only study: use lowest bilingual arm as reference
      ref_arm  <- min(non_ref$nma_arm)
      ref_rows <- non_ref |> filter(nma_arm == ref_arm)
      trt_rows <- non_ref |> filter(nma_arm != ref_arm)
      if (nrow(trt_rows) == 0L) return(tibble())
      
      pairs <- cross_join(
        trt_rows |> select(arm_trt = nma_arm, ppt_trt = ppt_group,
                           m_trt   = vocab_score_mean, sd_trt = vocab_score_sd,
                           n_trt   = N, age_trt = age_mean,
                           lang_trt = score_language, L1, L2),
        ref_rows |> select(arm_ref = nma_arm, ppt_ref = ppt_group,
                           m_ref   = vocab_score_mean, sd_ref = vocab_score_sd,
                           n_ref   = N, age_ref = age_mean,
                           lang_ref = score_language)
      )
    }
    
    pairs
  }) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(compare_group = as.numeric(compare_group))

es <- with(
  df_contrasts,
  smd_independent(m_trt, sd_trt, n_trt, m_ref, sd_ref, n_ref, type = "g")
)

df_contrasts <- df_contrasts |>
  bind_cols(es) |>
  filter(!is.na(y), !is.na(se_y))
```

```{r}
df_contrasts_t <- df_paired |>
  mutate(
    arm_1 = nma_arm_of(lang_group_1, vocab_measure),
    arm_2 = nma_arm_of(lang_group_2, vocab_measure),
    lang_1 = score_lang_of(lang_group_1, arm_1, L1_1, L2_1,
                           assessment_tool_L1_1, assessment_tool_L2_1),
    lang_2 = score_lang_of(lang_group_2, arm_2, L1_2, L2_2,
                           assessment_tool_L1_2, assessment_tool_L2_2)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(arm_1), !is.na(arm_2), arm_1 != arm_2,
         !is.na(t_score), !is.na(N_1), !is.na(N_2)) |>
  mutate(
    group1_is_ref = if_else(arm_1 == 1L | arm_2 == 1L, arm_1 == 1L, arm_1 < arm_2),
    arm_trt  = if_else(group1_is_ref, arm_2, arm_1),
    arm_ref  = if_else(group1_is_ref, arm_1, arm_2),
    ppt_trt  = if_else(group1_is_ref, ppt_group_2, ppt_group_1),
    ppt_ref  = if_else(group1_is_ref, ppt_group_1, ppt_group_2),
    m_trt    = if_else(group1_is_ref, vocab_score_mean_2, vocab_score_mean_1),
    m_ref    = if_else(group1_is_ref, vocab_score_mean_1, vocab_score_mean_2),
    sd_trt   = if_else(group1_is_ref, vocab_score_sd_2, vocab_score_sd_1),
    sd_ref   = if_else(group1_is_ref, vocab_score_sd_1, vocab_score_sd_2),
    n_trt    = if_else(group1_is_ref, N_2, N_1),
    n_ref    = if_else(group1_is_ref, N_1, N_2),
    age_trt  = if_else(group1_is_ref, age_mean_2, age_mean_1),
    age_ref  = if_else(group1_is_ref, age_mean_1, age_mean_2),
    lang_trt = if_else(group1_is_ref, lang_2, lang_1),
    lang_ref = if_else(group1_is_ref, lang_1, lang_2),
    t_signed = if_else(group1_is_ref, -t_score, t_score)
  ) |>
  filter(arm_trt != 2L | lang_overlap(lang_trt, lang_ref) %in% TRUE)

es_t <- with(df_contrasts_t, smd_from_t(t_signed, n_trt, n_ref, type = "g"))

df_contrasts_t <- df_contrasts_t |>
  bind_cols(es_t) |>
  filter(!is.na(y), !is.na(se_y)) |>
  select(short_cite, compare_group, vocab_type, vocab_units, infant_typical,
         assessment_procedure, arm_trt, ppt_trt, m_trt, sd_trt, n_trt, age_trt,
         lang_trt, arm_ref, ppt_ref, m_ref, sd_ref, n_ref, age_ref, lang_ref,
         y, se_y, var_y, d, g, J, L1 = L1_2, L2 = L2_2)
```

```{r}
lang_dist <- read_csv(here("data", "language_pairs.csv"))

df_contrasts <- bind_rows(df_contrasts, df_contrasts_t) |>
  mutate(age_c = (age_trt - grand_age_mean) / 12) |> 
  left_join(lang_dist, by = join_by(L1, L2))

key_trt <- paste(df_contrasts$short_cite, df_contrasts$ppt_trt)
key_ref <- paste(df_contrasts$short_cite, df_contrasts$ppt_ref)

key_all <- sort(unique(c(key_trt, key_ref)))

df_contrasts <- df_contrasts |>
  mutate(
    study_id   = as.integer(factor(short_cite)),
    comp_id    = as.integer(factor(paste(short_cite, compare_group, vocab_type))),
    ppt_trt_id = match(paste(short_cite, ppt_trt), key_all),
    ppt_ref_id = match(paste(short_cite, ppt_ref), key_all),
    paired     = as.integer(ppt_trt_id == ppt_ref_id)
  )

saveRDS(df_contrasts, here("outputs", "df_contrasts.rds"))
```

# Diagnostics
```{r}
# Confirm bi_L1 contrasts are all language-matched
matched <- df_contrasts |>
  filter(arm_trt == 2L, arm_ref == 1L) |>
  mutate(match = lang_overlap(lang_trt, lang_ref)) |>
  count(lang_trt, lang_ref, match)

lost <- anti_join(
  bind_rows(
    df_arms |> distinct(short_cite),
    df_paired |> distinct(short_cite)
  ),
  df_contrasts |> distinct(short_cite),
  by = "short_cite"
)
if (nrow(lost) > 0) message("Studies with no valid contrasts: ",
                            paste(lost$short_cite, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r}
sum_btw <- df_contrasts |> 
  mutate(between = arm_ref == 1L) |> 
  select(short_cite, between)

sum_sum_btw <- sum_btw |> 
  group_by(short_cite) |> 
  summarise(between = max(between)) |> 
  count(between)

sum_sum_btw
```
